propositions: Advanced command grammars (bridge, reconcile, audit, verify, workflow, identity) currently mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch and produce unsafe/incomplete help output
Parser factories must be extracted into lean, reusable modules with no dependency on optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor)
Parse-failure handling must be harmonized: ParseError raised by RebarArgumentParser must be caught and translated to identical exit code (2) and stderr bytes as current SystemExit behavior
Bespoke parser presentation (custom usage, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) must be preserved exactly for affected command families
All advanced routes must resolve to valid S2a parser factory references and construct successfully without executing handlers or importing optional runtimes
Argument-definition helpers must be reused across canonical nested bridge forms and compatibility commands (bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard, bridge-status)
